segments.name: Commercial-stage biotechnology
segments.description: A commercial-stage biotechnology company that develops and commercializes therapeutic innovations for acute care and oncology patients.
segments.evidence: We are a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on improving the lives of patients by developing and commercializing therapeutic innovations that improve medical care.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by specialty distributors and full line wholesalers in the U.S. that resell its products to healthcare providers and hospitals, the end users.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Products are distributed in the U.S. through a limited number of specialty distributors and full line wholesalers that resell to healthcare providers and hospitals, the end users of our Products.
